scope: One genuine read-only Java source contract/race-review task, not a connectivity probe.
validation_scope: This records one actual successful SSE exchange on the designated current LAN service, in addition to the separate offline mock checks.
It does not establish other operating systems, other servers, model weights/hardware, service capacity, cache effectiveness or a general tool loop.
Transport completion does not establish correctness or adoption of the source-review answer, runtime performance or downstream Game actions.
Raw source, task text, answer text, private evidence paths, stable machine/owner identifiers and credentials are excluded.
business_source_adoption: Not established by this transport report; separate owner review required.
